senses.gloss: ch. same, esp. (corresp. to h. מבוא העיר) city gate-way which is opened for wagons &c.; fortified place where judges sit &c.; cmp. שַׁעַר.—
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 22a">M. Kat. 22ᵃ</cite> begin to count the days of mourning <he>מבבא דא׳</he> from the time ye turn your faces from the city gate-way (to go home while the corpse is carried to the grave-yard).

Keth. 17ᵃ; Meg. 29ᵃ when people form a lane מא׳ ועד סיכרא from the city gate-way to the burial place. [Ar. house of mourning, v. אִבּוּל I.] B. Bath. 58ᵃ bot. there was written אבבא דא׳ Ms. M. (ed. incorr. בא׳) over the gate of the town entrance (where court was held).—Pl. אִבּוּלֵי.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 28:52">Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 52</cite> <he>אבוליכון</he> (ed. Vien. <he>אכול׳</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 50:26">Targ. Jer. L, 26</cite> <cite ref="A00070"><he>אִיבּוּלָהָא</he></cite> (h. text <he>מאבסיה</he>; v. Pesh. a. l.).
